Per rule, Inner Circles are not granted to have +2 bleed. So it makes no sense rule-wise that Al-Ashrad has +2 bleed. Just like it makes no sense that Dogs can ride bikes.
Nevertheless, the answer is correct. Effects from the base version and from the advanced version are cumulative.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Now you can speak freely. I sensed that you were restricted in the Rules Question forum

My question is: is it pertinent to say in the Rules Question forum something such as:

"Beast, The Leatherface of Detroit, has +1 strength. Which makes some sense as he has big muscles"?

(Having big muscles is as related to the +1 strength bonus as being Inner Circle is related to having +2 bleed.)

What if later someone points out: "I can't understand why X doesn't have +1 strength, as he has big muscles. It would make some sense."

Or the dreaded: "Underbridge shouldn't be able to use vehicles. It doesn't make sense."

You have 2 hours to answer
